recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Only revisit if FHIR-I makes a new decision to deprecate or forbid prev across Bundle.link guidance, link-relation terminology, and paging best practices.
issue_request: FHIR-42892 is an Applied/Persuasive FHIR-core technical correction for the Search page. It requested changing the Other Links - Paging common link list from prev to previous, aligning the wording with FHIR HTTP paging and RFC 5005.
initial_application: The issue was applied in source/search.html by FHIR-42892 commits 4264607320a718fe87107b675e1b54a335dda02e and a9d09524434be7b5eb57ba6b14aa7488d4241560, which changed prev to previous in the common paging link list and _count zero prose. Follow-up commit aa86f3b6a30573b01aa943b887da6514f75eb237 added an additional clarification listing both prev and previous and saying they are interchangeable.
additional_context: FHIR-I minutes for 2023-11-06 record FHIR-42892 in a 12-0-0 block vote. The current Search source lists both prev and previous, the local IANA link-relation code system defines previous as a synonym for prev, and later applied paging guidance in FHIR-51428 uses previous (or prev). These later/current sources support synonym-preserving wording rather than deleting prev.
reconciliation: No source edit was made. The reconciliation published an empty no-change audit commit on the combined branch because the current source satisfies the substantive issue request while retaining a recognized synonym.

related_jiras.note: Later applied paging best-practices guidance uses previous (or prev), supporting the current synonym-preserving Search wording.
